about: Seconds each flow and integration unit costs on a shard (its build, its tests, its replays), dealt out longest first onto the least loaded shard (`shard_of`). A unit missing here costs the stage's default. Seeded 19 Nov from the shard times of run 44529824328 (flow 4 to 13 minutes, integration 5 to 11); replace with measured task times once the ledger holds them. Keys are the unit names of `wf ci plan tests --json`: a package, `crate-<crate>`, or `crate-<crate>/<group>` for the groups of an integration suite.
